key_insight: Self-evolving agents often improve overall performance, but greater adaptability can undermine retention of earlier knowledge.
engineering_relevance: Engineering assistants adapting to new tools and workflows need regression checks to protect previously reliable capabilities.
method: Keep model weights frozen while adapting prompts, memory, or skills from task feedback.
Compare ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness across drifting task streams.
Assess adaptation, retention, and interference as topics, workflows, or domains shift.
evidence_signal: Across four streams built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld, self-evolution improved aggregate performance on most streams but exposed stability–plasticity trade-offs.
watch_item: The abstract reports no solid-mechanics-specific validation; global edits and conflicting memory retrieval remain deployment risks.
